claims.text: The hotel is in the heart of Dubai, on the doorstep of the city's business, finance, fashion and cultural hubs.

findings.quote: lifestyle destination in the heart of Dubai
on the doorstep of Dubai’s business, finance, fashion and cultural hubs

claims.text: Za'abeel is an affluent area in Bur Dubai on the border of Dubai International Financial Center, close to Downtown Dubai.

findings.quote: Za’abeel is an affluent area in Bur Dubai, on the border of Dubai International Financial Center, close to Downtown Dubai

claims.text: Dubai World Trade Centre is a short walk from the hotel.

findings.quote: Dubai World Trade Centre is just a short walk away

claims.text: The architecture is by Nikken Sekkei and the design by Jean-Michel Gathy's Denniston.

findings.quote: Featuring groundbreaking architecture by Nikken Sekkei and design by Jean-Michel Gathy’s Denniston

claims.text: The hotel is set in the One Za'abeel building, connected by the sky concourse The Link for destination dining.

findings.quote: set in the spectacular One Za’abeel building, connected by sky concourse The Link for destination dining

claims.text: Rooms have glass curtain walls that draw the eye to the horizon.

findings.quote: the glass curtain walls drawing the eye to the horizon

claims.text: Even entry-level rooms have a king-sized bed, a daybed and a bathroom with a standalone tub; Grand category rooms add a separate dressing room.

findings.quote: there's enough floorspace even in entry-level rooms for a king-sized bed, stretched daybed and bathroom with standalone tub
“grand” category rooms have a separate dressing room

claims.text: The spa is set over three floors and offers aesthetic and wellness treatments alongside longevity analysis.

findings.quote: Set over three floors, the spa offers aesthetic and wellness treatments alongside longevity analysis

claims.text: The spa has a hammam and hydrotherapy area, a steam room and a sauna.

findings.quote: a beautiful hammam and hydrotherapy area, steam room and sauna

claims.text: The infinity pool is suspended on the roof of The Link, with views toward the Burj Khalifa.

findings.quote: The infinity pool suspended on the roof of The Link is dotted with pool-chic couples enjoying the DJ’s relaxed tunes and views out towards the Burj Khalifa.

claims.text: There is a separate couples' pool.

findings.quote: A separate couples’ pool is a perfect parent hideaway

claims.text: Tapasake is a Peruvian-Japanese indoor-outdoor restaurant with pool deck dining on top of The Link.

findings.quote: At Tapasake, a Peruvian-Japanese, indoor-outdoor restaurant, a DJ provides an upbeat soundtrack for pool deck dining on top of The Link.

claims.text: The hotel has the UAE's longest suspended infinity pool.

findings.quote: the UAE’s longest suspended infinity pool

claims.text: The hotel sits in one of two towers linked by a cantilever.

findings.quote: The hotel sits in one of two imposing towers linked via a cantilever.

claims.text: The spa is a Longevity Hub by Clinique La Prairie, the first in the Middle East.

findings.quote: The first Middle Eastern Longevity Hub by Clinique La Prairie

claims.text: In The Garden on level four, Bali-inspired rice-paddy-style family pools have a swim-up bar.

findings.quote: Down at The Garden on level four, Bali is the inspiration for a series of sculpted rice-paddy-style, family pools with a swim-up bar.

claims.text: Sanctuary Suites are themed corner suites with their own treatment room.

findings.quote: Sanctuary Suite, one of three themed, corner suites, with its own treatment room

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the hotel is in a business district rather than on the beach.
Complimentary early check-in and late check-out are a suite benefit, subject to availability.

findings.quote: Suites enjoy complimentary early check-in and late check-out, subject to availability.

claims.text: Dubai International Airport is a 15- to 20-minute drive; the hotel can arrange luxury transfers.

findings.quote: We can arrange luxury transfers to the hotel from Dubai International Airport (just a 15- to 20-minute drive)
